# MA-HaMR

This repository combines two related research codebases for dynamic hand motion reconstruction and memory-augmented refinement experiments:

- `Dyn-HaMR/`: dynamic hand motion reconstruction code and supporting third-party integrations.
- `MA-HaMR/`: memory-augmented HaMR components, feature extraction scripts, export utilities, and experiment configuration.

## Repository Layout

```text
.
├── Dyn-HaMR/
├── MA-HaMR/
└── README.md
```

## Data And Generated Files

Local data and generated artifacts are intentionally excluded from version control. In particular, `Dyn-HaMR/_DATA/` is ignored and should not be uploaded to GitHub.

## Description

A combined Dyn-HaMR and MA-HaMR codebase for dynamic hand motion reconstruction, feature extraction, and memory-augmented refinement experiments.
